title: 第1章 焊盔第2章 深情对视
slug: 废墟探险家第325章回魂芭
content_zh:
莫斯科市中心往西大约100公里，一座大型水库南岸的高地上，郁郁葱葱的白桦林边缘藏着一座早已经废弃了许多年的回字形建筑。
有人说，这座边长百米的烂尾建筑，是专门为KB建造的最高级别疗养院。
也有人说，这里当年曾准备拿来当做KB的新总部，甚至专门修建了一条直通卢比扬卡的防核地铁专线。
更有传闻说，这里其实是苏联为领导人建造的核战避难所，同时也是克宫的紧急备用指挥所。
事实上，无论这座尚未彻底完工便遭废弃的建筑原本准备拿来做什么其实都无所**谓，它已经事实上的荒废并且被人彻底遗忘了。
在苏联解体后的第27个年头，莫斯科方面依旧穷的裆兜不住蛋，早已没有多余的卢布来支撑这些宏伟的苏联烂尾楼复工了。
不，别说复工，因为当年过于追求建造质量，官方如今想拆除这些用M800号混凝土浇筑的建筑都是个耗钱的麻烦——除非用核弹。
更何况，在这么个远离症痔中心的鬼地方，土地根本就不值钱，这座建筑本身也因为地下结构常年泡水早就没了复工的价值，又何必拆除它呢？
至于窃贼，这一点还真不用担心。
先不说这里就没有什么值钱的东西，按照毛子去年通过的机密法修正案，俄罗斯境内所有前苏联未解密军事设施均受保护，违法闯入或者盗窃，最高能判上7年。
不管这座烂尾建筑是否受内务部保护以及算不算军事设施，这条修正案已经足够吓退相当一部分老实人的好奇心了。
但也只是一部分，事实上依旧有相当数量的人对这些废弃的苏联建筑充满了兴趣。
这些人里有起码一大半只是为了所谓的探险、跟风探险、拍照、跟风拍照。
甚至不乏一些精力旺盛的鬼才在跟风之余，顺便在这种鬼地方拉着女伴或者男伴打个炮儿，或者解决一些需要藏匿尸体的私人恩怨。
剩下的那一小半，基本上都是黑金猎人。
黑金猎人，这个**称呼只是如同“峨嵋峰还**独照”一般，自带些浪漫主义气息的美化罢了。
事实上，这些人完全可以用“捡破烂儿”来进行精准概括。
一切能拆走且值钱的金属、非金属造物，都是这些人的目标。
在这其中，这些废弃建筑附近的村镇居民就占了相当一部分，而且大多时候会由他们拔了头筹。
不过好在，他们一般只对诸如铜电缆以及各种家具乃至门窗感兴趣。

也正因如此，那些被废弃的军事建筑即便被他们搬空，也依旧藏着不少的财富。
除了这些地头蛇，还有一批人盯上的是这类建筑可能遗存的各类略显烫手的军事设备，比如军车、武器乃至任何稀罕玩意儿。
这其中既有一些把破烂儿捡回去修好当爹供着的收藏家，也有把破烂捡回去修一修再卖到非洲的军火商。
更有一些大忽悠，甚至能随便捡一些根本不值钱的破烂，将它们切成挂件，再进行一番苏维埃式的包装之后卖个高的离谱的情怀价。
当然，还有一些真正的技术党，或者说真正意义上的黑金猎人。
这些人看上的，是这些废弃建筑里隐藏的黄金，字面意义上以及化学元素周期表上的那种，耀眼的、迷人的、但却藏在最不起眼的电路板背面的黄金。
这些真正的黑金猎人常年流窜于这些废弃的军事建筑之中，是如“熬硝佬”一般隐秘的存在。
也正是在这些“苏维埃熬硝佬”里，却掺杂了一个喜欢在下雨天动手的异类。
白起，能给孩子起这个名字的，要么是对抗路玩魔怔了，要么是总想挖个坑埋点啥。
已经摸到这座废弃建筑内部地下二层，此时正忙着把脱下来的衣服藏起来的小伙子虽然也叫白起，但给他起名字的那位老爷子既不知道什么叫对抗路，大概也没打算挖坑埋点儿啥。
甚至，他虽然叫白起，但实际上写在纸上却是“白芑”。
按照古意，又或者按照老爷子花了101块钱请的那位算命先生的说法，白芑是好谷种的意思。
这百里挑一的好名字，倒是精准契合了老爷子对自家大孙子“种儿好才能出好苗儿”的美好心愿。
种儿到底好不好这件事先放在一边有时间再去验证，对于白芑自己来说，他现在的时间可不多。
按照他入行之后一直以来的习惯，他喜欢在暴雨天来这种地方炼金，这自然是有深刻原因的。
一来，暴雨天很少遇到其他人以及可能存在的看守，而且下雨天的噪音也能掩盖很多不小心弄出来的动静，继而避免很多不必要的麻烦。
二来，充沛的雨水可是炼金的必要条件，这能让他不用背上一包沉重却又必须的矿泉水。
content_en:
About 100 kilometers west of the center of Moscow, on the high ground on the south bank of a large reservoir, there is a zigzag building that has been abandoned for many years hidden on the edge of a lush birch forest.
Some people say that this unfinished building with a side length of 100 meters is the highest-level sanatorium specially built for KB.
Some people also say that this place was planned to be used as the new headquarters of KB, and a special anti-nuclear subway line was even built directly to Lubyanka.
There are even rumors that this place was actually a nuclear war shelter built by the Soviet Union for leaders, and it was also an emergency backup command post for the Kremlin.
In fact, it doesn't matter what the building was originally intended for, as it was abandoned before it was fully completed. It was de facto abandoned and completely forgotten.
In the 27th year after the disintegration of the Soviet Union, Moscow is still poor and has no spare rubles to support the resumption of construction of these magnificent Soviet unfinished buildings.
No, let alone resumption of work, because they were too focused on construction quality back then, and now it would be a costly hassle for the officials to demolish these buildings made of M800 concrete—unless they use nuclear bombs.
What's more, in such a ghost place far away from the center of hemorrhoids, the land is worthless at all. The building itself has long lost the value of resumption of work because the underground structure has been soaked in water all year round, so why bother demolishing it?
As for thieves, you really don’t have to worry about that.
Not to mention that there is nothing valuable here. According to the amendment to the Secrets Law passed by Maozi last year, all undeclassified military facilities of the former Soviet Union in Russia are protected. Illegal break-ins or thefts can be sentenced to up to 7 years in prison.
Regardless of whether this unfinished building is protected by the Ministry of the Interior and whether it is considered a military installation, this amendment is enough to scare away the curiosity of quite a few honest people.
But that's only part of it. In fact, a considerable number of people are still interested in these abandoned Soviet buildings.
At least half of these people are just for the so-called adventure, following the trend of adventure, taking pictures, and following the trend of taking pictures.
There are even some energetic ghosts who follow the trend and take the opportunity to have sex with female or male companions in such ghost places, or resolve some personal grudges that require hiding bodies.
The remaining half are basically black gold hunters.
Black Gold Hunter, this nickname is just like "Emei Peak is still alone", with some romanticism to beautify it.
In fact, these people can be accurately summarized as "rag pickers".
All metal and non-metallic objects that can be dismantled and are valuable are the targets of these people.
Among them, residents of villages and towns near these abandoned buildings account for a considerable part, and most of the time they take the lead.
But fortunately, they are generally only interested in things like copper cables and various furniture and even doors and windows.
Because of this, even if those abandoned military buildings were evacuated by them, they still contained a lot of wealth.
In addition to these local snakes, there are also a group of people who are eyeing the various slightly hot military equipment that may be left in such buildings, such as military vehicles, weapons and even any rare gadgets.
Among them are some collectors who pick up rags and repair them as gifts for their fathers, and there are also arms dealers who pick up rags and repair them before selling them to Africa.
There are even some big scammers who can even randomly pick up some worthless junk, cut them into pendants, package them in Soviet style and sell them at ridiculously high sentimental prices.
Of course, there are also some real technical parties, or black gold hunters in the true sense.
What these people are interested in is the gold hidden in these abandoned buildings, the kind of gold in the literal sense and on the periodic table of chemical elements, the dazzling and charming gold, but hidden on the back of the most inconspicuous circuit board.
These real black gold hunters roam these abandoned military buildings all year round.In the building, there is a hidden existence like "The Nitrogen Man".
It is precisely among these "Soviet gangsters" that there is an alien who likes to do things on rainy days.
Bai Qi, anyone who can name their child this is either because they are crazy about playing against the road, or because they always want to dig a hole to bury something.
They have reached the second underground floor of this abandoned building. The young man who is busy hiding the clothes he took off is also named Bai Qi, but the old man who named him does not know what confrontation road is, and he probably has no intention of digging a hole to bury anything.
Even though his name is Bai Qi, it is actually written on paper as "Bai Qi".
According to ancient meaning, or according to the fortune teller whom the old man spent 101 yuan to hire, Baiji means good grain.
This one-of-a-kind name accurately fits the old man’s wish for his eldest grandson: “A good seed can produce a good seedling.”
Whether Zhong'er is good or not should be put aside until he has time to verify it. For Bai Qi himself, he doesn't have much time now.
According to his habit since he entered the industry, he likes to come to places like this to do alchemy on rainy days. There is naturally a profound reason for this.
First of all, you rarely encounter other people and possible guards on rainy days, and the noise on rainy days can also cover up a lot of accidental movements, thereby avoiding a lot of unnecessary trouble.
Secondly, abundant rain is a necessary condition for alchemy, which saves him from carrying a heavy but necessary bag of mineral water.
